fact_check.claim: Visiting scholars have no guaranteed Cornell housing
fact_check.note: brief: no guaranteed housing for visiting scholars, Cornell Sun 2024-11-12.

fact_check.claim: Hasbrouck takes rolling applications on 12-month contracts
fact_check.note: brief: rolling applications; $620-$1,530 on 12-month contracts; same scl.cornell.edu grad housing URL.

fact_check.claim: Dec-Jan spring-semester supply is mostly sublets and semester leases; Ithaca Renting lists 'Spring/Fall Semester 2027' rows
fact_check.note: brief states this wording verbatim; source ithacarenting.com/collegetown/ appears in the brief.

fact_check.claim: Dec 31: spring-entering degree students' free first-year TCAT rides end
fact_check.note: brief: Dec 31 for spring entrants, same fcs.cornell.edu page.

fact_check.claim: Visiting scholars' bus status is not in our sources
fact_check.note: brief's bus rows cover degree students, PhD/GAs, registered others and spouses; no visiting-scholar row, so the page's hedge is accurate.

fact_check.claim: July 31: most Ithaca leases end, next start about August 1 (209 Stewart listing)
fact_check.note: brief gives July 31 (Cornell Sun 2024) and the listing term; the page cites the listing, which matches the term.

fact_check.claim: On a month-to-month give one month's notice; a fixed-term lease needs none at its end
fact_check.note: brief: none at the end of a fixed term; month-to-month generally one month (RPL 232-b); same Cornell Law URL.

fact_check.claim: Guide 1 covers the whole market (2026-27 guide)
fact_check.note: title 'Off-campus housing at Cornell: the 2026-27 guide'; matches.

fact_check.claim: Guide 2 covers Cornell options for scholars, furnished rooms, lease or no lease
fact_check.note: meta: no guaranteed housing, International Scholar House, Hasbrouck, semester sublet; consistent.

fact_check.claim: Guide 3 covers sublets from the subtenant's side
fact_check.note: meta and the 'Taking an Ithaca summer sublet' figure match.

fact_check.claim: Guide 4 covers what you owe if you sign for 12 months and leave after six
fact_check.note: article warns about signing a 12-month lease for one semester; its worked example is a five-month empty stretch. 'After six' is a loose round figure for the example, not a hard fact; left unchanged.

fact_check.claim: Guide 5 covers where semester leases and sublets are posted
fact_check.note: article mentions sublets and semester leases (10 matches); meta is about College Pads and Ithaca Renting but the body covers it.

fact_check.claim: Guide 6 covers signing from abroad and renting without a US credit history
fact_check.note: article has a 'Before you send money from abroad' section and a 'Not confirmed' line on no-US-credit-history screening; the page promises topic coverage, not a screening answer.

fact_check.claim: Closing link: grad-students guide for a degree program or longer appointment
fact_check.note: title 'Where Cornell grad students live in Ithaca, and when to look'; matches.
